name: Terrace Sahn
summary: A domed prayer hall rises behind a deep diamond courtyard, resting on a single raised terrace.
why: The diamond court, front terrace, minaret and prayer hall form one polygon. The hall dome, entrance and court share x=54. The court is a large true opening; the contrasting front face describes architectural depth rather than an extra object.
risk: At 24px the raised court is more apparent than its depth; the domed hall and minaret remain the mosque cues.

sub2: The front face belongs to the building
